document.abstract: This paper will first look at the traditional applications in the areas of video, HDTV, film and print, and how they are historically inter-related. The technological advances of each will then be studied, and the trends in inter-discipline relationships examined from a technical stand point. The creative aspects of mixing media will then be discussed, and the advantages and pitfalls looked at in some detail. Finally an extrapolation of current trends will be carried out, and illustrations of what is possible today, and tomorrow, will conclude the presentation.

authors.bio: David Scammell graduated from Brunel University, Middlesex in 1978 with a B.Sc. in Physics and Electronics. After a brief spell with Marconi Space and Defense systems he joined Quantel as a Development Engineer. In 1982 he became Head of Applications Group, and during this time was responsible for supporting many of the major systems, including the DPE 5000 Plus. and more recently the Harry Suite. He is currently the Senior Product Manager, responsible for all broadcast products. He is married with two children, ages 5 and 7. Scammell is a member of SMPTE, and a regular contributor to the Television Conferences.
